# Polish source fixtures

Trimmed HTML returned by Polish Wiktionary's MediaWiki parse API on 2026-09-22. Source: https://pl.wiktionary.org/wiki/{word}. `uczyć się` redirects to `uczyć`, whose entry has separate non-reflexive and reflexive tables. Fixture titles retain the canonical source title.

© Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Navigation, media, unrelated fields and non-German translations are removed. Tables retain merged cells, nested additional forms and potential-form markers to test extraction and Markdown portability. These are offline regression fixtures, not a runtime dictionary.
